tools.name: generate_aging_report
tools.description: Use this when the user wants an accounts receivable aging report (AR aging report, aged receivables, 'who owes me money and how late', ar aging report template filled in) from open invoices typed in chat, pasted as CSV/TSV, or attached as a CSV/XLSX export from QuickBooks, Xero, FreshBooks or Wave.

tools.name: generate_customer_statements
tools.description: Use this when the user wants customer statements (customer statement template, statement of account, open item statement) for customers who owe them money, from the same open invoices: typed, pasted CSV/TSV, or an attached CSV/XLSX export. findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: generate_aging_report, generate_customer_statements · Public sink: generate_aging_report, generate_customer_statements.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: generate_aging_report, generate_customer_statements · Public sink: generate_aging_report, generate_customer_statements

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
